name: Live desktop
description: Watch this desktop's screen live from the phone as video, on the same connection as everything else, with bandwidth presets; optionally click and type into it. macOS, and Windows with the host running in WSL. A small helper (wp-desktop: Swift on the Mac, C# on Windows, compiled by the compiler Windows already carries) captures, encodes and posts input; it is built on first use. Experimental.

settings.label: Let the phone control this desktop
settings.note: Clicks and keys from the phone reach every app on this desktop, with the same trust as typing into a session. Off: the phone can only watch.
